study_identification_part.si4_title: A 10-Year Longitudinal Study of Brain Cortical Thickness in People with First-Episode Psychosis Using Normative Models

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: To characterize 10-year longitudinal trajectories of cortical thickness deviations in first-episode psychosis and test their associations with symptoms using normative models.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: TOP study; Multi-site aggregated dataset for normative modeling
rci1_dataset_name.reason: The study recruited participants from the TOP study. Normative models were estimated using a collection of publicly available datasets, but these individual datasets are not explicitly named in the text, so a general qualifier is used.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: All participants were recruited to a specific first-episode sub-study of the TOP study...Normative models for cortical thickness estimated on public MRI datasets...Using pooled data from a collection of mostly publicly available datasets from 77 sites, and 40 435 participants...
rci1_dataset_name.location: Berthet2025.pdf.md: Participants, Paragraph 1; Normative Modeling, Paragraph 1

rci2_hc_n.reason: The paper clearly states the large reference training set comprised 40,435 participants with 95% used for training. The longitudinal test sample sizes for healthy controls are clearly stated in Table 1 at each timepoint (baseline=218, 12 months=197, 10 years=77).
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: Using pooled data from a collection of mostly publicly available datasets from 77 sites, and 40 435 participants, the reference normative models were first trained on (95%) healthy individuals and validated on an independent set of 2548 CTRL and patients (5%, stratified by sites)... rci5_imaging_modality.reason: The paper explicitly describes T1-weighted structural MRI acquisition across three different scanners with specific pulse sequences: MPRAGE on 1.5T Siemens, FSPGR on 3T GE HDxT, and BRAVO on 3T GE 750 Discovery. No other imaging modalities are mentioned.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: Three scanners at Oslo University Hospital were used in this longitudinal study without temporal overlap. The first scanner was a 1.5 Tesla Siemens MANETOM Sonata scanner with a 32-channel head coil. T1-weighted images were acquired using an MPRAGE sequence... The second scanner was a 3 Tesla GE Signa HDxT with an 8HRBRAIN coil. T1-weighted images were acquired using an FSPGR sequence... The third scanner was a 3 Tesla GE 750 Discovery scanner with a 32-channel head coil. The T1-weighted images were here acquired using a BRAVO sequence... T1-weighted structural MRI scans were preprocessed through Freesurfer (version 5.3), and CT measures were parcellated using the Destrieux atlas.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: CT deviations in patients attenuate over 10 years; ACC deviations relate to PANSS total, and insular/orbitofrontal deviations to PANSS negative scores.
